title: Sightings at Los Alamos from 1948

tellings.quote: And then you have Los Alamos, like even as early as I believe like 1948, they're being seen there.

plain: Unexplained objects were being seen over Los Alamos, the New Mexico laboratory where the atomic bomb was built, as early as about 1948. A researcher who goes by the online name RedPandaKoala tells Michels this, hedging the date with "I believe" and naming no source, as part of a case that UFOs gather around nuclear sites.
